scope: Episode-bound clearance lane partner preference during true resume
finding: Clearance admission reads resumePairs from the matched CLEAR operation/episode roster and prioritises its participants, but later CombatPairs rebuilt actual pairs from CBE_CombatPairs alone. A lagging general registry can therefore preserve older intact pair combinations even when all intended participants survived the resume admission.
counterexample: With eligible roster A,B,C,D, matched clearance lanes A+B/C+D and lagging general pairs A+C/B+D, participant ordering alone cannot prevent the old helper preserving A+C/B+D.
implementation: CombatPairs gains optional fourth preferred-pair array, default empty and bounded to16rows. Before the existing general-registry pass, only intact preferred pairs wholly within already-qualified remaining actors are retained. All other actor eligibility, orphan repair, nearest selection, out-of-scope preservation and publication stay unchanged. CortexClearBuilding passes its matched resumePairs only when useResumeRoster is true, inside the existing commitPreparation gate. Ordinary/new-clear callers retain empty preference.
authority: Metadata preference only, no native command/target/route, no changed eligibility or new recruitment. Existing building/transform/hard-deadline/visit-context roster binding and RESUME_ROSTER_CHANGED admission checks remain. No pair preference can return actors outside the supplied eligible set.
cost: At most16 extra preferred rows on explicit use; no world query, ray, worker, timer or scan of unsupplied actors. Normal default preference loop is empty. Runtime/performance budget unmeasured.
remaining: Does not establish ordered public snapshots, latest-roster replication, full entry/sweep route-state adoption or physical normal/HC continuity. New-member floor/entry receipts remain mandatory. Master build-out figures not renewed.

validation.note: Existing resume contract extended; two guarded call-signature assertions updated after initial full failure. Final pipeline passed.

provenance: Unsigned dirty development snapshot based on698b3278 plus implementation and unrelated pre-existing dirt; private review/handover postdate build.
